name: ad-creative
description: Checks ad copy and ad creative text before it runs, and reads creative tests after. Counts fields against Google search and Performance Max, LinkedIn limits and TikTok's suggested caption length, screens each line against the Google, Meta and TikTok ad rules and US and UK claim rules listed in the plugin, and gives fixed text with the rule named. Tells you which ad won, whether the gap is real or noise and whether the comparison was randomised. Also drafts Google search and paid social ad text, and ad angles from reviews you paste, using only the facts you give. Works only on text and numbers you paste; makes no images or video and changes nothing in any ad account.

interface.longDescription: Five skills for checking ad text before it runs and reading creative tests after. Ad creative preflight counts each field of the ad text you paste against Google search and Performance Max limits (Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters count 2), LinkedIn single-image and carousel limits and TikTok's suggested caption length, screens every line against the platform rules listed in the plugin (Google editorial and pinning rules, Meta's personal-attribute rule, TikTok's absolute-claim, link and AI-label rules) and US FTC and UK CAP claim rules, and gives the smallest fix with the rule named. Ad test readout judges the winner on your main metric, says whether a gap is real or noise and whether the ads were randomised, adjusts for several variants and flags a possible sample-ratio mismatch. Search ad set and social ad set draft ad text from the facts you give, with no invented figures; any three search headlines read well together. Angle matrix turns reviews and comments you paste into ad angles, each traced to what customers said. Limits the plugin does not list are not quoted. No images, video, spending or account changes.
defaultPrompt: Rule-check this Reels ad: 'Struggling with anxiety? AcmeCalm is the #1 app doctors recommend — 50% off today only!'
Ad A: 40,000 impressions, 520 clicks, 26 sales. Ad B: 38,000, 610, 22. Same ad set, 10 days. Which one won?
15 RSA headlines + 4 descriptions for a payroll app. Facts: 14-day trial, no card to try, from $39/mo, setup in one day.
